title: DFT structural relaxation of undoped BaHfN2
action: Perform structural relaxation of BaHfN2 using ABINIT with LDA HGH pseudopotentials (Ba, Hf, N) including semicore states. Start from the experimental geometry (tetragonal P4/nmm, a=4.128 Å, c=8.382 Å, internal coordinates from literature).
description: Relaxed geometry required for all subsequent electronic and vibrational property calculations.

title: Compute indirect band gap of undoped BaHfN2
action: Using the relaxed undoped structure, perform a SCF calculation and band structure calculation to determine the indirect band gap (in eV). Write the gap value to band_gap.txt.
description: Indirect band gap of undoped BaHfN2 obtained from LDA DFT.
output_schema: Single float on the first line, representing the gap in eV.

title: Determine conduction band minimum orbital character
action: Compute the projected density of states or fatbands to identify the dominant orbital character at the conduction band minimum. Write the result (e.g., 'Hf 5d_xy') to cbm_character.txt.
description: Dominant orbital character of the lowest conduction band.
output_schema: Single string on the first line.

title: Compute Born effective charges
action: Use ABINIT DFPT to compute the Born effective charge tensors for all atoms in undoped BaHfN2. Write the results to bec.txt in tabular format.
description: Born effective charges (in units of e) for Ba, Hf, N1, and N2. The tensor is diagonal in tetragonal symmetry.
output_schema: Table with columns: atom (string), Zxx (float), Zyy (float, equal to Zxx), Zzz (float). One row per distinct atom.

title: Compute dielectric constants
action: Using ABINIT DFPT, compute the high-frequency (ε∞) and static (ε0) dielectric tensors for undoped BaHfN2. Write the xx and zz components to dielectric.txt.
description: Components of the macroscopic dielectric tensors.
output_schema: Four floats on separate lines: epsilon_inf_xx, epsilon_inf_zz, epsilon_0_xx, epsilon_0_zz.

title: Compute zone-center phonon frequencies (undoped)
action: Use ABINIT DFPT to calculate zone-center phonon frequencies for undoped BaHfN2, including LO-TO splitting for IR active modes. Write the mode labels, symmetries, and TO/LO frequencies to phonon_undoped.txt.
description: Zone-center TO and LO phonon frequencies for the insulating undoped BaHfN2.
output_schema: Table with columns: mode_label (string), symmetry (string), frequency_TO (float, cm⁻¹), frequency_LO (float, cm⁻¹; empty for Raman modes). One mode per row.

title: Create and relax Ba0.5La0.5HfN2 structure
action: Replace one Ba atom in the BaHfN2 unit cell with La, then relax the lattice constants and internal coordinates using ABINIT with LDA HGH pseudopotentials (Ba, Hf, La, N) including semicore states. Start from the experimental undoped geometry.
description: Process step: relax the doped structure to obtain the correct geometry for subsequent phonon calculations.

title: Compute doped phonon frequencies
action: Using the relaxed Ba0.5La0.5HfN2 structure, compute zone-center phonon frequencies with ABINIT DFPT. The system is metallic; no LO-TO splitting is reported. Write the mode labels and frequencies to phonon_doped.txt.
description: Zone-center phonon frequencies for the La-doped metallic system (Ba0.5La0.5HfN2).
output_schema: Table with columns: mode_label (string), frequency (float, cm⁻¹). One mode per row. Degenerate modes are listed per pair.
